The Vintage-style Lambeth cakes are really on trend at the moment. 
Choose from a single heart cake, tiered heart, circular, square or rectangle mar shaped cake.  Piped with fancy Lambeth style buttercream swirls and edged piping for that classic vintage feel.  We can add bows, cherries and central wording. 

Our single vintage style cakes are designed to be collected from us for connivence.  Therefore delivery is not included in the price. If delivery is preferred  please request a quote.
